subject: Req: Temporary block and complete subprocessor inventory for Fintegral integration
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <psharma@fintegral.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodai.com
Cc: security@fintegral.com, Marcus Lee <mlee@fintegral.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary block + full subprocessor inventory before integration

Hi Dylan,

We're moving forward with the Fintegral <> Redwood POC but our security team has flagged one of your downstream vendors (Acme EdgeOps) for additional due diligence. For the next 10 business days we need Redwood to:

- Place a temporary provisioning block on Acme EdgeOps for Fintegral tenant data (no new exports or replication to that processor)
- Provide a complete subprocessor roster (all vendors that process customer data for this integration) with data categories and locations
- Supply dataflow diagrams showing where Fintegral customer data traverses (including edge proxies, analytics, and backups)
- Evidence of SOC2 / equivalent controls for any processors handling customer PII, and the DPA we executed with them if available

We need to treat this as a dependency for our procurement sign-off. Please reply with an ETA and any immediate concerns. If possible, include a contact for your security/compliance team.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Security Programs
Fintegral Inc.
psharma@fintegral.com

Attachment: none (we know this is an ask to Redwood)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodai.com>
To: Priya Sharma <psharma@fintegral.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary block + full subprocessor inventory before integration

Priya — thanks for the flag and the clear list. We can do this.

Plan (high level):
1) Temporary block: we'll place a provisioning hold on Acme EdgeOps for the Fintegral tenant within 24 hours; this will prevent any new exports or replication. Existing stored data will remain accessible per the retention policy unless you request otherwise.
2) Inventory & diagrams: I will have a curated subprocessor roster and a dataflow diagram to you within 48 hours (CSV + PNG).
3) Evidence: we'll attach SOC2 attestations or equivalent and any DPAs we have with downstreams; if a downstream is not audited we'll flag and provide compensating controls.
4) Point of contact: Laura Bennett (cc) will own the evidence package and coordinate with your security team; Ben Carter (cc) will handle any contract/DPA redlines.

Next steps for us: Laura — can you confirm the roster export + annotated dataflow and attach any SOC2s/DPA PDFs? Ben — please pre-draft a short notice to Acme EdgeOps (we may ask them to pause provisioning for the Fintegral tenant) and hold on executing any provisioning changes until Priya confirms.

Priya — ETA from our side: temporary block within 24 hours; roster and dataflow + initial evidence within 48 hours; DPA redline turnaround depends on your legal team but Ben will coordinate.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary block + full subprocessor inventory before integration

Dylan / Priya — attaching the items we discussed. We exported the subprocessor roster from the infra catalog and annotated the column that indicates processing purpose and data categories. Highlights and caveats are in the CSV comments.

Summary (short):
- Attached roster (subprocessor_roster_20260721.csv): lists all processors used by the Fintegral integration path. Acme EdgeOps is listed as an edge caching/replication processor; they do not hold the primary KV encryption key.
- Dataflow (dataflow_v2.png): shows flow from API -> edge proxy -> inference runtime -> analytics/billing. Backups live in S3 (region: us-west-2).
- Evidence: we have SOC2 Type II for the majority of our infra vendors; Acme’s attestation is currently limited to a self-assessment. We flagged that in the roster.
- DPA: enclosed are current DPAs we maintain where available. One redline we expect from Fintegral is around export restrictions — Ben will coordinate.

Temporary block request: We can implement a tenant-level provisioning hold on Acme EdgeOps immediately for Fintegral. That will prevent any further replication/export. Current data will remain per Fintegral's retention settings unless you instruct otherwise.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (within 4 hours): temporary block applied and we confirm by email
- Within 48 hours: full evidence package (SOC2s/DPAs) delivered
- Ben will share a draft communication to Acme EdgeOps before we send it.

Attachments:
- subprocessor_roster_20260721.csv (roster + flags)
- dataflow_v2.png (annotated)
- DPA_redlines_Fintegral.pdf (Ben's initial redlines for your review)

Laura Bennett
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com

Subject: Re: Request: temporary block + full subprocessor inventory before integration

Laura / Dylan — thank you, received. The roster and dataflow look good at a glance. A few clarifying Qs that we'll raise on the call:

- For Acme EdgeOps: can you confirm whether they receive any unencrypted PII (names, emails) in the replication path? If so, how is it masked/encrypted in transit?
- For backups: what is the retention policy and who has access keys?

We're scheduling a 30-min call with our compliance Ops this Friday at 09:00 PT to walk through the evidence (invitation incoming). In the meantime we'll log a temporary hold on vendor provisioning on our side as well.

Ben — thanks for preparing the DPA redline; we'll review and push DocuSign if it's acceptable: https://app.docusign.com/secure/sign/Fintegral-Redline-2026

Priya
